scripts.build:js: terser assets/js/config.js assets/js/ui.js assets/js/tts.js assets/js/mic.js assets/js/app.js -o assets/js/bundle.min.js -c -m
scripts.build:css: cleancss -o assets/css/bundle.min.css assets/css/main.css assets/css/animations.css assets/css/header.css assets/css/cards.css assets/css/controls.css
scripts.build: npm run build:js && npm run build:css
scripts.watch: nodemon --watch assets --ext js,css --ignore assets/js/bundle.min.js --ignore assets/css/bundle.min.css --exec "npm run build"
